decision: Use core-owned incremental constrained transaction + final canonical validator; do not brute-force complete legal-alternative enumeration.
model: Unconstrained integer allocations of D damage among k recipients = C(D+k-1,k-1); rules filters reduce some cases but simultaneous groups multiply search spaces.
performance_rule: Correctness is mandatory. Performance optimization may change representation but may not move legality into provider/pilot.

specific_cases.case: one attacker / one blocker without modifier

specific_cases.note: Amount to blocker ranges from lethal L through D; rest may spill.
No general damage order under CR 510.1c-d.
CR 702.19b counts other same-step assigned damage; independent per-source option enumeration can be incorrect without shared transaction state.
Complete alternative materialization can become millions/billions of allocations even before combining simultaneous groups.
